ashley: heads up — noticed a repro on qwen2.5 perf after yesterday's kernel-selector change.
ashley: baseline microbench (multilang: en+zh+ja) jumped ~12% p99 and ~1.4x tokens/sec cost when seq_len > 512.
ashley: quick logs: ```
req_id=3f2a kernel=auto selected=autokernel_v2 latency_p99=312ms latency_prev=278ms tokens=1024
kv_cache_miss=0.12 kernel_fallbacks=4
```
sam: can you paste profiler flamegraph link? also do we know if kv-head dims changed for that model config?
ashley: flamegraph: https://perf.internal/graphs/2065437890-flame.png (high CPU in matmul+kv-gather path)
perf-bot: scheduled profile job #2065437901 for qwen2.5 multilang at commit be4f9d2 — artifacts: https://perf.internal/artifacts/2065437901
kavi: quick thought — were we shipping the tokenizer update at the same time? CJK token splits drastically change seq length distribution.
ashley: yes tokenizer bump merged ~yesterday morning. but initial repro runs used mixed traffic; i can isolate with synthetic corpus.
maria: @ashley please run: `./bench/run_infer.sh --model qwen2.5 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --kernel auto --tokenizer v2` and then `--kernel legacy` to compare.
ashley: ran both. results:
```
--kernel auto: p50 120ms p95 220ms p99 315ms tokens/s 860
--kernel legacy: p50 118ms p95 210ms p99 268ms tokens/s 1180
```
ashley: forcing legacy removes the p99 spike and tokens/s improves ~37%.
sam: interesting — suggests kernel-selector picked autokernel_v2 incorrectly for this workload. do we have kernel selection rules that consider kv_head_dim != attn_head_dim?
kavi: model config: qwen2.5 has attn_heads=32, kv_heads=64 (KV head packing). rope scaling applied per-head, might be misaligned in autokernel when it assumes equal heads.
sam: that mismatch can change memory layout: our autokernel expects packed KV shape (B,seq,heads,head_dim_kv) vs runtime giving (B,seq,kv_heads,head_dim_kv). If selection logic only looked at total_kv_dim, it could choose wrong kernel.
maria: can you grep selector logs? `grep kernel_selector /var/logs/infer/*.log`
ashley: selector log snippet: ```
[11:03:21] kernel_selector: model=qwen2.5 total_kv_dim=4096 chosen=autokernel_v2 reason="best_latency_estimate"
[11:03:21] kernel_selector: assumptions: heads=32 head_dim=128 kv_heads=32 (inferred)
```
ashley: note: it inferred kv_heads=32 incorrectly (should be 64).
kavi: that explains it. tokenizer expanding seq lengths + wrong kernel = worse batching heuristics and more KV operations.
sam: root cause candidates: a) selector inference logic for kv_heads fails when kv packing used, b) autokernel_v2 has RoPE scaling path that assumes attn/kv head parity, c) tokenizer changes increase seq distribution past threshold exposing a bad kernel fallback.
perf-bot: regression delta detected: 12.1% p99 increase vs baseline; correlated with commit be4f9d2 (kernel-selector) and tokenizer v2.
maria: short mitigation: pin qwen2.5 to legacy kernel in serving config while we fix selector. add a runtime flag `prefer_legacy_for:qwen2.5` in rollout config.
ashley: did quick canary with that flag enabled for 10% traffic — p99 returned to baseline.
sam: long term fix: selector should read explicit model metadata (kv_heads, attn_heads) from model manifest instead of inferring. also update autokernel_v2 to validate assumptions and fallback earlier.
kavi: i'll run a bisect on selector inference — a minimal test: run selector with synthetic model manifest variations and assert parsed kv_heads==manifest. starting now.
ashley: for repro, sharing minimal repro container: `docker run -e MODEL=qwen2.5 reg.internal/repro:perf-2065437890` includes scripts and the small corpus.
maria: i'll open a patch: (1) emergency rollout config to pin legacy for qwen2.5 (2) selector manifest-read change (3) add unit test for mismatched head packing + RoPE path.
sam: also add a perf test in CI: synthetic multilang tokenizer sample + seq distribution to catch tokenization-driven regressions.
perf-bot: job #2065437920: canary run with `prefer_legacy_for:qwen2.5` shows p99 back to 269ms, tokens/s +36% — marking job PASSED.
ashley: thanks all — i'll keep monitoring. assigning follow-ups: @kavi selector bisect, @maria rollout + tests, @sam autokernel validation.
kavi: starting bisect now, will post logs. :mag:
maria: created ticket INF-4217 and a quick PR draft at https://git.internal/repo/pulls/2456
sam: i'll pair on autokernel fixes tomorrow morning.
ashley: closing loop: major takeaways — kernel selection must use authoritative model metadata, tokenizer changes can surface kernel assumptions, RoPE/head packing asymmetry needs defensive checks. :white_check_mark:
